items.summaryZh: 一项对超过 10 000 名足球运动员进行的全国性队列分析显示，在重返赛场的球员中，移植物选择（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与翻修前交叉韧带重建的风险无关，无论是男性还是女性球员。
items.curatedReasonEn: In football players, graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) is not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction. This implies that clinicians can select grafts based on patient characteristics and preferences without undue concern for reinjury risk after ACL reconstruction.
items.limitation: 研究数据来自全国性队列分析，无法排除所有潜在的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on nationwide cohort analysis, which cannot exclude all potential confounding factors.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite junior and senior TeamGym gymnasts established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance, finding significant sex × age-group interactions for hop distances, with senior males outperforming junior males and senior females, and males completing more heel raises than females.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究首次提供了精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模值。这些运动特异性基准数据对你在康复和重返赛场评估中具有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模值
items.summaryZh: 一项针对216名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的横断面研究建立了下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模值。研究发现，跳跃距离存在显著的性别×年龄组交互作用，资深男性在所有跳跃指标上均优于青少年男性和资深女性，且男性完成的提踵次数多于女性（平均差异 4.60，95% CI 1.91-7.30）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in elite TeamGym gymnasts. These sport-specific benchmarks are valuable references for your rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪运动员表现随时间的变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design, which cannot track changes in athlete performance over time.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring neurorehabilitation patients' perceptions of fundamental care in an Italian rehabilitation hospital found that patients valued hygiene, mobility, and comfort as contributing to dignity, and emphasized respectful communication, emotional support, and continuity as central to feeling safe and supported.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了神经康复患者在基础护理中对尊严、机构感和情感安全的需求，提示我们超越任务驱动，关注以人为中心的护理，这能指导你调整康复团队的沟通和支持策略。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待他们的基本护理需求？一项定性研究的发现
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究发现，意大利一家康复医院的神经康复患者将卫生、行动和舒适视为有尊严的体验，并强调尊重沟通、情感支持和持续性是获得安全感和支持的关键。研究凸显了以人为本护理的重要性，超越了单纯执行物理任务。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights neurorehabilitation patients' needs for dignity, agency, and emotional safety within fundamental care, suggesting a shift from task-oriented to person-centered approaches. This can guide adjustments in your rehabilitation team's communication and support strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性分析，且仅在一个意大利康复医院进行，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study was conducted in a single Italian rehabilitation hospital, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 US older adults from 2011-2024 found that stroke history was independently associated with a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38) after adjusting for covariates.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在美国社区居住的老年卒中幸存者中，恼人的和限制活动的疼痛患病率显著高于非卒中老年人。了解卒中后疼痛的负担和独立关联，有助于你在老年卒中康复中更好地进行疼痛评估和管理。
items.titleZh: 美国社区居住老年卒中患者与非卒中老年人疼痛负担和活动受限情况的横断面分析（2011-2024）
items.summaryZh: 一项对2011-2024年美国12,797名社区居住老年人进行的横断面分析发现，卒中病史与较高的恼人疼痛（OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66）和活动受限疼痛（OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）患病率独立相关。卒中组恼人疼痛患病率为60.77%，活动受限疼痛为62.83%，均高于非卒中组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that bothersome and activity-limiting pain is significantly more prevalent among community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke in the U.S. compared to those without stroke. Understanding the burden and independent association of post-stroke pain will help you improve pain assessment and management in geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法建立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional analysis, preventing the establishment of a causal relationship between stroke and pain.

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: This study found that submaximal graded cycling exercise up to vigorous intensity was well-tolerated by both mothers and fetuses in singleton and twin pregnancies, with few differences in acute maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses between groups, providing high-quality evidence to inform exercise advice.
items.curatedReason: 单胎和双胎妊娠的女性，进行中等到高强度（submaximal graded cycling up to vigorous intensity）的运动是安全的，且母胎心血管反应差异不大。这项观察研究提供了有价值的数据，支持临床上鼓励双胎孕妇在适度活跃范围内进行运动。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中等至高强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，单胎和双胎妊娠女性进行中等到高强度分级自行车运动时，母婴均能良好耐受，且母胎急性心血管反应差异不大。这为双胎妊娠女性的运动建议提供了高质量证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise is safe for women with both singleton and twin pregnancies, with minimal differences in maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses. This provides strong evidence for exercise advice in twin pregnancies, allowing you to confidently provide exercise guidance.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量未明确报告，且结局指标仅限于急性反应。
items.limitationEn: The sample size of this study was not explicitly reported, and outcome measures were limited to acute responses.

items.title: Time to act: why menopause should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine
items.summary: This article emphasizes the importance of menopause in sports and exercise medicine, noting its impact on musculoskeletal pain, bone mass, cardiovascular disease risk, and physical performance in women, and calls for greater prioritization of this life stage.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了绝经期在运动和运动医学中的重要性，因为它会对女性运动员的肌肉骨骼健康、心血管疾病风险和运动表现产生影响。这提示你，在评估和管理女性运动员时，应更全面地考虑其绝经状态。
items.titleZh: 时不我待：为什么绝经期应成为运动医学的优先关注点
items.summaryZh: 本文强调了绝经期在运动和运动医学中的重要性，指出其对女性肌肉骨骼疼痛、骨量、心血管疾病风险和身体表现的影响，呼吁将这一生命阶段作为优先关注点。
items.curatedReasonEn: This perspective highlights the importance of menopause in sports and exercise medicine due to its impact on musculoskeletal health, cardiovascular disease risk, and athletic performance in female athletes. This suggests you should more comprehensively consider menopausal status when assessing and managing female athletes.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and facilitators influencing Austrian physiotherapists' adherence to CPGs and return to sport criteria after ACLR. Key barriers included limited CPG usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, resource limitations, and interprofessional misalignment, while facilitators included structured guidelines, professional development, and institutional support.
items.curatedReason: 临床实践指南（CPG）在 ACLR 康复中的依从性仍不理想。本研究揭示了依从性的障碍（指南可用性、患者期望、专业态度、跨专业协作差）与促进因素，你可以借此审视自身实践，寻找改进点。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项奥地利的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响奥地利物理治疗师依从前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）后临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素。主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、专业态度、资源限制和跨专业协作不良，而促进因素则包括结构化指南、专业发展和机构支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) in ACLR rehabilitation remains suboptimal. This study reveals barriers (guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, poor interprofessional collaboration) and facilitators of adherence, offering insights to review your own practice for improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（9 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 physiotherapists), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary study found that single-session high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased FDS MEP amplitudes by ~22.3% in chronic stroke patients, though not statistically significant, suggesting potential enhancement of corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: 高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练可能在单次干预后增强卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。结果虽未达统计学显著，但趋势积极，值得继续关注其长期效果。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练对慢性卒中患者皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练可使慢性卒中患者的指深屈肌（FDS）运动诱发电位（MEP）幅度增加约 22.3%，尽管未达统计学显著，但提示可能增强皮质脊髓兴奋性。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises may enhance corticospinal excitability in stroke patients after a single session. Although not statistically significant, the positive trend warrants continued attention to its long-term effects.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（7 名慢性卒中患者），且为单次干预的初步研究，需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This preliminary study has a small sample size (7 chronic stroke individuals) and only examines a single session, requiring larger studies for confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: This commentary describes a clinical framework for implementing and interpreting quality of movement assessment tools during rehabilitation and return-to-sport decision-making for pediatric and adolescent patients following ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 在青少年 ACLR 术后康复中，你应该考虑将运动质量评估纳入重返运动决策。这能让你更全面地评估患者 readiness，潜在降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年 ACL 重建术后运动质量评估：指导康复和重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 本评论描述了一个临床框架，用于在前交叉韧带重建术后的青少年患者康复和重返运动决策中，实施和解读运动质量评估工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: In pediatric and adolescent ACLR rehab, you should consider incorporating quality of movement assessments into return-to-sport decisions. This provides a more holistic readiness assessment and may reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，不涉及原始数据或系统性证据，其建议的强度低于实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a clinical commentary, not based on original data or systematic evidence, so its recommendations have a lower level of evidence than empirical studies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report of a world-class female wrestler after pectoralis major repair showed that force plate-based assessment of maximal (NPF) and rapid (NF200) isometric shoulder strength, particularly NF200, lagged behind NPF recovery and was angle-dependent.
items.curatedReason: 力板评估可实时监测胸大肌修复术后世界级摔跤运动员的肩部力量恢复，尤其快速发力能力恢复滞后于最大力量，且存在角度依赖性。这对你的重返运动评估是个提醒：关注多维度和快速力量指标。
items.titleZh: 世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后重返运动过程中最大和快速等长肩部力量的力板评估：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后的病例报告显示，基于力板的最大（NPF）和快速（NF200）等长肩部力量评估中，NF200 的恢复滞后于 NPF，并具有角度依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Force plate assessment can monitor shoulder strength recovery in a world-class wrestler after pectoralis major repair, revealing that rapid force production lags behind maximal strength and is angle-dependent. This is a reminder for your return-to-sport evaluations: focus on multidirectional and rapid force metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的普适性极低，仅能提供初步的临床观察和方法学参考。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very low, offering only preliminary clinical observations and methodological references.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: This commentary proposes an integrative model for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the protective roles of feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact. It clarifies why pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric-strength training are crucial for injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论指出，预防非接触性 ACL 损伤的关键在于强化落地前的襠绳肌预张力及肌联蛋白刚度。这意味着你的预防和康复训练应更侧重于落地策略的优化和离心力量训练。
items.titleZh: 非接触性 ACL 损伤的感觉运动和分子机制：一种整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 本评论提出了一种非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合模型，强调了触地前前馈脕绳肌张力和肌联蛋白僵硬在保护中的作用。它阐明了为什么触地前落地策略和离心力量训练对损伤预防至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact are crucial for non-contact ACL injury prevention. Your prevention and rehabilitation strategies should therefore emphasize optimizing pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为理论模型和临床述评，不包含实验数据验证，其提出的假说需未来实证研究支持。
items.limitationEn: This study is a theoretical model and clinical commentary, lacking experimental data validation, and its proposed hypothesis requires future empirical support.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide cohort study of 511 athletes with preinjury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 undergoing primary ACLR found that 62% returned to preinjury activity levels within 24 months, with an average duration of 12.3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究显示，高活跃度 ACLR 术后运动员在 24 个月内，62% 返回术前 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的运动水平，平均历时 12.3 个月。该数据为你与患者沟通重返运动预期提供了更精确的参考，并可识别高风险未能完全返回的患者。
items.titleZh: 高 Tegner 活动评分（≥7）运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返运动：一项纵向全国性注册队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 511 名术前 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的初次 ACL 重建运动员进行的纵向全国性队列研究发现，62% 的运动员在 24 个月内恢复到术前活动水平，平均历时 12.3 个月。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that 62% of highly active athletes undergoing ACLR returned to pre-injury Tegner Activity Scale score ≥7 within 24 months, with an average duration of 12.3 months. This data provides a more precise reference for you when discussing return-to-sport expectations with patients and can help identify high-risk individuals who may not fully return.
items.limitation: 研究的结局指标是患者报告的 Tegner 活动评分，可能存在主观性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study's outcome measure is the patient-reported Tegner Activity Scale score, which may introduce subjective bias.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes, identifying pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations, leading to inconsistent guidance and heightened uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后经历中，教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织普遍存在与残疾相关的知识空白。这提醒你，在为这类特殊人群提供康复支持时，需特别注意弥补这些知识不足，提供个性化指导。
items.titleZh: 精英残疾运动员怀孕和产后经历的考察：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究考察了精英残疾运动员的怀孕和产后经历，发现教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织普遍存在与残疾相关的知识空白，导致指导不一致和不确定性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sports organizations regarding the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes. This highlights the need for you to address these knowledge deficits and provide individualized guidance when supporting this special population in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性描述性研究，样本量未具体说明，结论的普遍性有限，主要提供洞察而非量化证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative descriptive study with an unspecified sample size, limiting generalizability and primarily offering insights rather than quantitative evidence.
